𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸𝗱𝗮𝘆'𝘀 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀
 𝗦𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲: 𝗥𝘀 𝟭𝟰𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 - 𝗥𝘀 𝟮𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 (𝗶𝗲 𝗜𝗡𝗥 𝟭𝟰-𝟮𝟬 𝗟𝗣𝗔)
 Experience: 5+ yrs
 Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

 As a QA Mobile Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated tests for both iOS and Android mobile applications, ensuring high quality and reliability across multiple device platforms. Leveraging your strong background in Java and Appium, you will collaborate closely with development and product teams to create robust testing frameworks that integrate seamlessly into continuous integration pipelines. Your role will involve analyzing test results, troubleshooting failures, and providing actionable feedback to speed up the release cycle. By maintaining comprehensive test documentation and staying current with industry best practices, you will help deliver premium mobile experiences to users worldwide.

 𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀
 • Design and develop scalable automation frameworks using Appium and Java for iOS and Android platforms.
 • Create, maintain, and expand automated test suites that cover functional, regression, and performance scenarios.
 • Integrate automation tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.) to enable rapid feedback loops.
 • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to understand feature requirements and identify testable acceptance criteria.
 • Execute automated test runs, analyze results, and log defects in a coordinated bug tracking system.
 • Perform code reviews and provide constructive feedback to developers on testability and code quality.
 • Research and implement new tools, libraries, or practices that improve automation coverage and efficiency.
 • Document test strategies, scripts, and execution outcomes for audit and compliance purposes.
 • Mentor junior QA engineers and guide them in best practices for mobile test automation.
 • Continuously monitor and optimize test performance and stability across diverse device configurations.

 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗮 𝗚𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁 𝗙𝗶𝘁
 • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
 • 5 to 6 years of hands‑on experience in mobile automation testing for iOS and Android.
 • Proficiency in Java, with strong object‑oriented programming skills.
 • Expert knowledge of Appium, including TouchAction, driver architecture, and parallel test execution.
 • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests within a CI/CD environment.
 • Solid understanding of mobile app architectures, native and hybrid app testing, and related frameworks.
 • Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills, with a track record of quickly diagnosing test failures.
 • Strong communication abilities, able to articulate complex technical issues to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
 • Knowledge of performance and security testing concepts for mobile applications.
 • A proactive attitude toward continuous learning and staying updated with evolving mobile testing trends.
